name: Bond market volatility
summary: Treasury volatility index MOVE near 95 on 27 Nov, below the 100 line; US 10-year yield 4.94%
state: The MOVE index of Treasury volatility closed near 95.3 on 27 Nov, 10% lower on the week and below the 100 Watch line, though 36% higher over three months (Yahoo Finance). The US 10-year yield ended near 4.94%, about 5bp lower on the month and inside the 40bp line (Yahoo Finance). The data floor keeps Watch while MOVE sits near the boundary; no disorderly auction or emergency Fed action was found.
for_you: Bond markets are calmer than earlier in November. Mortgage and loan rates tied to US Treasury yields remain near multi-year highs.
rubric_hit: Data floor Watch: MOVE 95 near 100 line; 10y 1m move 5bp < 40bp

sources.title: Yahoo Finance — ICE BofAML MOVE Index (^MOVE)

why: US Treasuries price almost every asset on earth; when the 'risk-free' market becomes volatile, funding and collateral chains strain.
drivers: Inflation data, Fed path, deficits and auction demand, foreign holder flows, liquidity.

rubric.alert: MOVE > 140, or disorderly Treasury trading (failed/tailed auctions with Fed action, emergency buybacks).
rubric.watch: MOVE 100–140, or US 10y moved ≥ 40bp in a month, or weak auctions flagged.
rubric.normal: MOVE index < 100 and US 10y moved < 40bp over the past month.
